This section contains projects highlighting my skills in Python and C#.

## Python Projects

__Project 1__: [College Fantasy Football](/Story_Telling/college_fantasy_quarto.qmd)

This program creates, keeps track of, and scores a college fantasy football league, using the principle of programming with functions. It also uses .txt files to store information for the league.

## C# Projects

__Project 1__: [Music Practice Room](/Story_Telling/practice_room.qmd)

This program works as a practice log for musicians. It keeps track of all practice entries, including songs practiced and scales used. It also has a metronome built in.
